offline.title: Offline practice · DartsPoint
offline.heading: Your next good throw.
offline.intro: Stop your direction first, then your height. You can keep practising without a connection.
offline.directionInstruction: Stop your direction with the red button or the space bar.
offline.heightInstruction: Stop the height now. Your dart will then fly towards the board.
offline.finished: Great checkout! Start a new leg whenever you like.
offline.bust: Bust. Back to your score at the start of the turn.
offline.note: This practice mode works entirely offline. Your Elo rating stays the same.
offline.scored: {label} · {score, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}. Stop your next direction.
